briefdescription.para: Audio preprocessing chain orchestrator (frozen Phase 1 API).

detaileddescription.para: Chains together resampling, noise suppression, echo cancellation, VAD, and normalization in a fixed order (see file header for chain diagram).
Thread Safety: NOT thread-safe. Each stream should have its own instance. Use one instance per streaming session.

Error Handling: All methods use fail-closed semantics:
process() returns success=false and error_message on any pipeline error
Methods return sensible defaults or empty results on failure
No exceptions are thrown
